scope: One client-lifetime immutable package-version snapshot attempt only
candidate: baseline plus clients/local.py lazy version snapshot; frozen copy before measurements
inputs: same four existing synthetic PNG fixtures and existing pinned NIMA/SSD/YuNet assets as prior audit

protocol.compiled_cache: unique absent directory per process, retained within its repetitions
protocol.result_cache: cleared before each repetition; normal intra-repetition priming reuse

acceptance.bounded_complexity: one lazy instance field and moved dictionary construction; no new dependency, model or global cache

stop: If gate fails, revert only this runtime attempt and retain results. No alternate optimization or expanded RAW/hardware experiment.
boundary: No production review, photos/XMP modification, deployment, source search or model/default changes. Batch commit/push authorized after verification.
